Record resource naming, auth matrix, exact identity/idempotency/status/errors, finding versions, reproduction approval, pagination/export integrity and CLI compatibility; synchronize internal draft transport fixtures and scenario mapping without advertising unimplemented public endpoints. One contract owner approves shared fixtures before parallel client/Checks development.

Exact-subject finding/history reads, bounded stable pagination and integrity-verifiable complete export work over real HTTP. Wrong scope, invalid cursors and interrupted/truncated exports fail explicitly; M3-C11 export capability is retained.

Operator-authorized mutations enforce expected versions, operation IDs and immutable approved plans with configured consumers. Reject request-supplied commands/images/budgets; verify cancellation before/during staging, termination cleanup and retained receipts; never-staged cancellation stays unverified.

Typed client and executable CLI consume shared fixtures and pass real-server review/finding/reproduction/export round trips after routes are implemented. Verify identity/digests, bounded reads, auth/cancellation/errors/exit codes, no credential logging and preservation of released agentci review behavior. Parallel development does not replace final real transport acceptance.

Renderer and actual publication keep synthetic/unconfirmed claims advisory, bind exact subject/version/evidence, escape bounded output, reject stale heads and prevent retries overwriting newer results. Develop against frozen contracts; accept only when integrated status and evidence URLs work.

Controller-owned bounded immutable approval registry resolves strict caller selectors to exact current finding/version and approved queue successor, assertion inputs and runner policy. Reject unknown fields, changed digest/subject/version, duplicate registry IDs and mutated plans; detached outputs and invalid lifecycle cases remain safe. Document atomic queue/reservation/dispatch and real HTTP/PG/Temporal as dependent c3 acceptance, with no production route claim.

Real PostgreSQL proves full-selector replay, exact admitted-review membership, conflicting operation and stale-version rejection, and one atomic authorized queue event, immutable plan, operation receipt and dispatch intent. Concurrent duplicates and injected transaction failures cannot strand partial state. No production dispatcher or HTTP route is enabled; Temporal and customer transport remain original c3 acceptance.

Explicit hosted-only raw Git object reuse preserves fresh repository authorization, commit/tree identity and existing bounded verified blob cache; cold/seeded snapshots match and actual Git fixtures prove no candidate checkout, replacement/hook/lazy fetch, corrupt/hash/size/UTF8/oversize acceptance or cross-repository reuse. Missing local objects fall back to REST; subprocess time/output/concurrency and cache bounds remain enforced. Redacted counters distinguish local/memory/remote byte sources and proven local cooldown rejections; fast/build/API and applicable mutation checks pass, structural request estimates remain separate from hosted measured velocity.

Reviewed exact-source hosted verification/advisory and packaged documentation establish publication acceptance; prior quota failures remain retained and no milestone release is claimed by local checks alone.

Review an explicit additive migration and typed source decision preserving legacy M2 stage/digest/comparison/export contracts and evaluator least privilege; no fabricated legacy evidence. Real PostgreSQL admission-only staging validates immutable plan/operation/admission lineage, replay, substitution, corruption and cancellation. Existing M2 persistence/lease/checkpoint/recovery and compatibility acceptance remain passing; no HTTP or production consumer activation.

Explicit operator config revisions resolve exact retained finding/plan and trusted snapshots; durable apply uses CAS with revocation/expiry checks and no stale startup resurrection. Separate authenticated non-execution proof binds scope/plan/operation/version and keeps execution receipt null; never-staged cancellation can transition to unconfirmed/error and fresh authorized retry without rewriting execution evidence. Real PostgreSQL races/replay and additive history version compatibility pass; no HTTP or worker activation.

Real PostgreSQL proves prepared immutable admission-backed inputs stage through the caller-owned transaction: injected final rejection and lost connection leave zero jobs/units, commit/replay preserves one typed job/unit, corruption/cancellation remain fenced. Existing standalone staging and legacy M2 contracts remain unchanged. No permission implementation, Temporal dispatch or public route is enabled; full consumer/recovery and released customer acceptance remain open.
